projectDesc.p: DoCTA edits the inventories and account books of the Tyrolean territorial administration; this file is produced by the project's agentic edition pipeline from the Transkribus export.

editorialDecl.p: The text of this file is unrevised machine transcription. It was produced by a vision-language model reading the Transkribus facsimiles and has not been reviewed by an editor, so every reading is provisional and the file is not a citable edition text. Transcription is diplomatic: the wording and spelling of the source are kept, nothing is normalised, expanded or corrected, and lineation follows the source, one lb per written line.

It(em) in dem undtern staingaden
1/2 läg(e)l pfeil.
It(em) ain fueter kăstel im undt(er)n staing[---].
It(em) in meins h(er)ren stuben vier scht[---]
tisch, der viert in d(er) ander(e)n stubn.
It(e)m in dem ergkar gen d(er) Schãrnitz
ain tȃrispũchß(en).
It(em) in dem arckãr gen Seveld wertz
fúnff clotz(e)n puchsen.
It(em) mer daselbs III hagk(e)n püchsen
und ain claine pũchsen.
It(em) ain metz(e)n puxenpulver.
It(em) in d(er) kuchen ain alte speistruhen
und ain speis käst(e)l.
It(em) in dem hinter kraut keller ain
mȯrser.
It(em) alle pettstat new und alt
nach ausfart des Clam(m)ers
sind alle der Burckhartin von
Hausen, hat sÿ im gschloß
gelassen wer ir das bezalt.
It(em) ain eÿsne häl ob dem herd
ist auch der Purckhartin vo(n)
Hausen.

Inventari was Pangracz(e)n
Hanen auf Slosperg
ingeantwurt ist.
